name: Gamepull.io
summary:
GamePull is a browser-based pack-opening and collection game where each card represents a real video game.
Players open packs to collect titles of varying rarity based on popularity, complete franchise sets, and trade cards through a server-synced marketplace.

The game features a central currency used to acquire packs, trade with other players, and buy listed cards.

Rare shard drops can appear from high-demand games, with each title split into four collectible parts. Collecting all four shards allows a player to craft a unique Relic, with only one Relic ever existing per game.
